assumptions.axis: Derived line between means of authored jaw capsule anchors; not a measured hinge
assumptions.softMotion: Prescribed disc-condyle rigid cluster with harmonic superior soft-lining weights; inferior rigid co-motion
assumptions.wall: Outward-normal scalar compliant superior mode tapered into hard/contact anchors; uncalibrated
assumptions.fluid: Uniform pressure, two resistive lines and scalar wall spring; computational closure treated as sealed. No CFD, cannula resistance calibration, cavitation, leakage or clinical safety inference
assumptions.distraction: Prescribed inferior disc-condyle co-translation, disc shape preserved in this mode; upper soft tissues interpolate between fixed temporal and moving disc. No calibrated traction or tissue force law.
assumptions.contact: Continuous rigid bone/disc guard and full instrument sweep; strict sampled rebuilt-domain self-intersections; 0.00002 mm extent/penetration tolerance for Float32 clipping; not a force solver
assumptions.motionFlow: Moving-geometry backward Euler with boundary exchange per accepted 0.1 s step
